Input: {"question": "What does the term \"Ibanag\" refer to?", "segments": [{"id": "s0", "text": "Ibanag people The Ibanag (also Ybanag and Ybanak or Ibanak) are an ethnolinguistic minority numbering a little more than half a million people, who inhabit the provinces of Cagayan, Isabela and Nueva Vizcaya."}, {"id": "s1", "text": "They are one of the largest ethnolinguistic minorities in the Philippines."}, {"id": "s2", "text": "The endonym \"Ibanag\" comes from the prefix \"I-\" which means \"people of\", and \"bannag\", meaning river."}, {"id": "s3", "text": "This toponym-based name is similar to the unrelated etymology for the Tagalog people, which is derived from \"taga-\" (\"person from\") and \"ilog\" (\"river\") The Ibanag language (also Ybanag) is spoken by about 500,000 speakers in two of the northeasternmost provinces"}]}
